description: Renovate merges its own minor and patch updates of stable (>= 1.0) packages outside infra/ once every check on the branch is green; everything else — majors, any update to a 0.x package, replacements, security fixes, anything under infra/ — waits for a human. It merges directly as its own app (platformAutomerge off): main has no required status checks, so GitHub's native auto-merge would merge before CI finished.

packageRules.description: infra/ is routed to infra review by CODEOWNERS. Renovate merges past that requirement, so updates there (Terraform provider lockfiles) must wait for the review instead.

Hold npm releases for three days before proposing them. A merge to main reaches the production runs, which hold the inventory and Slack credentials, so the version Renovate proposes must not be hours old; the wait gives the registry and the community time to catch and pull a compromised release. Renovate also passes npm the same cutoff (--before) when it regenerates the lockfile, so transitive versions it re-resolves are held too, except when a version already locked is newer than the cutoff, where it retries without one. Scoped to npm because it always reports release timestamps; a datasource that does not would have its updates held indefinitely.
